summary: In June 2025 Evans introduced a House resolution declaring 'Free Palestine' an antisemitic slogan, and on the October 7 anniversary in 2026 he posted that he stands with Israel and Colorado's Jewish community. A campaign-claimed endorsement from the Republican Jewish Coalition, alongside his resolution targeting pro-Palestinian speech, marks him a defender of Israel. Vote for Peace opposed him in the general, and the UDP-linked 314 Action Fund spent $54,218 against him.
